name: Civil Geotechnical Consultants and Dalara Foundation Scholarship (UQ)
provider: University of Queensland, Civil Geotechnical Consultants and Dalara Foundation
summary: Two-year scholarship for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander UQ coursework students in financial need.
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
